def test_deed_with_satisfaction_text_is_not_hijacked_as_release():
    """A DEED whose legal text mentions 'satisfaction of' (e.g. conveyance
    in satisfaction of a judgment) must stay in the chain of title — it must
    never be reclassified as a release and dropped from the report."""
    deed = _exam_doc(
        "d1", "deed.pdf",
        _doc_ext(documentCategory="DEED", documentType="WARRANTY DEED",
                 recordedDate="2015-03-01",
                 grantors=["ROBERT JONES"], grantees=["JOHN A SMITH"],
                 legal={"fullText": "conveyed in satisfaction of that judgment"}),
    )
    result = examine_documents([deed])
    assert result["examinations"]["d1"]["role"] == "schedule_a"
    assert result["report"]["schedule_a"] is not None


def test_undated_deed_is_never_schedule_a_vesting_candidate():
    """An unparseable recorded date previously sorted LAST, making the
    undated deed the vesting candidate. It must route to review instead,
    and the most recent DATED deed takes Schedule A."""
    dated = _exam_doc(
        "d1", "dated.pdf",
        _doc_ext(documentCategory="DEED", documentType="WARRANTY DEED",
                 recordedDate="2010-09-30",
                 grantors=["ROBERT JONES"], grantees=["JOHN A SMITH"]),
    )
    undated = _exam_doc(
        "d2", "undated.pdf",
        _doc_ext(documentCategory="DEED", documentType="WARRANTY DEED",
                 recordedDate="March 5th, 1985",  # unparseable
                 grantors=["SOMEONE OLD"], grantees=["ROBERT JONES"]),
    )
    result = examine_documents([dated, undated])
    exams = result["examinations"]
    assert exams["d1"]["role"] == "schedule_a"
    assert exams["d2"]["role"] == "review"
    assert "Recorded date is missing or unparseable" in exams["d2"]["rationale"]


def test_all_deeds_undated_means_no_schedule_a_only_review():
    deed = _exam_doc(
        "d1", "deed.pdf",
        _doc_ext(documentCategory="DEED", documentType="WARRANTY DEED",
                 grantors=["ROBERT JONES"], grantees=["JOHN A SMITH"]),
    )
    result = examine_documents([deed])
    assert result["examinations"]["d1"]["role"] == "review"
    assert result["report"]["schedule_a"] is None


def test_extraction_warnings_force_review_overlay():
    """A document with an incomplete extraction (failed batch / unrendered
    page) must never receive a confident automated disposition."""
    ext = _doc_ext(documentCategory="EASEMENT", documentType="UTILITY EASEMENT",
                   recordedDate="1980-05-01")
    ext["extractionWarnings"] = ["Extraction batch failed for pages 5-8: timeout"]
    ease = _exam_doc("e1", "easement.pdf", ext)
    result = examine_documents([ease])
    exam = result["examinations"]["e1"]
    assert exam["role"] == "review"
    assert "EXTRACTION INCOMPLETE" in exam["rationale"]
